Sam (AtlasIQ): Quick ask — we're running a product demo for 08:30 SGT tomorrow. Need a short-lived allowlist + regional steering to singapore edge and a QPS bump for ~3 hours. This demo is the final step before sign-off on the renewal.
Maya (CS): Copy. Can you drop the exact source IPs, domain/SNI and expected peak numbers? Also want to know if you control the cert CN.
Sam (AtlasIQ): IPs and SNI below. We control the cert. Expect sustained ~1.8k QPS with occasional spikes to ~3k for a few mins. Window 3 hours, start 08:30 SGT.
Sam (AtlasIQ): ```
198.51.100.21
198.51.100.22
2001:db8:85a3::21
SNI: demo.api.atlasiq.com
```
Rohan (NetOps): Please confirm CIDR (/32) and whether you need IPv6 mapped. Which APAC region? ap-southeast-1 (sg) or ap-northeast-1?
Sam (AtlasIQ): Please route to ap-southeast-1 (sg). Include IPv6 entry. Cert CN = demo.api.atlasiq.com. We can provide cert fingerprint if you want.
Elena (SRE): Proposed policy: steady_qps=1800, burst_qps=3200, auto_revoke=36h. Health triggers: if p95 latency >1.0s for 3m OR 5xx rate >2% for 3m, throttle to 600 qps and page SRE. Also add a soft fallback route to eu pool at 400 qps.
Maya (CS): Auto-revoke 36h is fine. Sam — the procurement reviewers will want written notes on the rollback triggers and expected monitoring—I'll prepare that.
Rohan (NetOps): I'll create ticket INF-6127 and stage the allowlist. Confirm the JSON payload before I push: ```allowlist:["198.51.100.21/32","198.51.100.22/32","2001:db8:85a3::21/128"], region:"ap-southeast-1", steady_qps:1800, burst_qps:3200, revoke_after_hours:36, sni:"demo.api.atlasiq.com"```
Sam (AtlasIQ): Confirmed JSON looks good. We will run an internal load smoke at 08:15 SGT.
infra-bot: INF-6127 created by Rohan (NetOps). Approvers: @Elena (SRE) @Maya (CS). ETA: ~70 minutes to schedule and push config.
Elena (SRE): I'll also add a temporary tracing span for that traffic and set elevated retention for 48h so CS can pull perf graphs for procurement.
Maya (CS): Great — Sam please DM me the smoke results and any logs if you see TLS handshake issues. We'll escalate immediately if the health triggers fire. :thumbsup:
Sam (AtlasIQ): Will do, thanks everyone. Appreciate the fast turnaround — this demo seals the renewal if perf is clean.
